founders.founder_bio: Engineering leader with over 10yrs leading engineering efforts for companies in different stages; Passionate about knowledge sharing and education, especially those that help other developers grow or get people into software development; likes to mentor/coach. If you have anything in mind, send me a message @noeBranagan. Currently, co-founder & CTO @ Ruffo making cross-border real estate transactions easy for everyone.

M&A and capital markets attorney for 8+ years at Simpson Thacher (NYC and Palo Alto).
